thread:
support-ian: Hi team, customer reported a discrepancy: dashboard shows ~4.1k tokens for a session but invoice billed ~5.4k. Happens only when client performs a session handoff (SSE -> reconnect).

alex: any request_id or example session id?

support-ian: provided session_id=sess_9x7a and request_id=rq_2026_ka. Happened twice in last 48h across different regions. Customer says client dropped the connection then reconnected to continue the stream.

maria: sounds like a partial-generation edgecase. Do we have server logs for sess_9x7a?

support-ian: pasted logs below (redacted):

```
2026-03-12T14:22:01Z INFO stream_start sess=sess_9x7a request=rq_2026_ka model=redwood-v2 tokens_emitted=312
2026-03-12T14:22:11Z WARN client_disconnect sess=sess_9x7a reason=TCP_RST
2026-03-12T14:22:11Z INFO buffer_flush sess=sess_9x7a emitted_trailer=true trailer_tokens=18
2026-03-12T14:22:12Z INFO session_resume sess=sess_9x7a request=rq_2026_kb model=redwood-v2 tokens_emitted=1020
2026-03-12T14:22:12Z ERROR duplicate_finalize sess=sess_9x7a ledger_write_id=ld_4452 conflict=true
```

alex: ERROR duplicate_finalize is suspicious. Could be ledger wrote both during the first disconnect flush and again at resume finalize. That would double-charge some tokens.

tanvi: customer-side: when the client reconnected they sent a resume token. Did client get a final "done" event before disconnect?

support-ian: customer says no final done; they got last chunk, then RST. We flush trailer on disconnect to avoid cold-lose, then resume flow also finalizes later.

maria: can you capture the SSE frames (from proxy) around that time? need to see if we marked a partial_final frame vs streaming_continue.

support-ian: proxy dump (trimmed):

```
-> event: chunk
data: {"delta":"...","seq":12}
-> event: chunk
data: {"delta":"...","seq":13}
-> event: close
code: 1006
-> event: chunk
data: {"delta":"...","seq":14}  <-- after resume from same client
-> event: final
data: {"tokens":133, "status":"complete"}
```

alex: That close code 1006 indicates abnormal close. We probably triggered disconnect-flush which wrote trailer_tokens=18 and also the later resume final wrote tokens again. ledger_write_id shows conflict=true so dedupe path didn't avoid double-count.

tanvi: action items: (1) ask payments to hold invoice for this customer until we audit, (2) reproduce locally with short reconnect and tcp rst, (3) add stricter idempotency on ledger finalize when conflict=true, and (4) update dashboard to show "pending finalization" when a disconnect triggers a flush.

sre-bot: created incident INC-2026-042 for "session handoff duplicate finalize" and assigned to eng-runtime.

maria: I'll try a repro harness. Can you share the customer's exact SDK version and plumbing?

support-ian: SDK: js-sdk@3.2.1, using eventsource polyfill on mobile. Customer also attached a HAR and small repro repo. Uploaded to /mnt/support/sess_9x7a-repro.tar.gz.

alex: payments-bot, can you pause billing for invoice inv_8774 while we investigate?

payments-bot: pausing invoice inv_8774 — reason: under investigation (support ticket ST-2241). Will notify customer.

tanvi: repro notes for eng-runtime: try reconnect with RST within 50ms of emitting a trailer, see if ledger duplicate occurs. If reproduce, add a blocking check that searches for pending_trailer(session_id) before writing finalize.

maria: FYI, if we find we double-wrote the same tokens we should credit the customer retroactively and issue a one-off ledger correction rather than refunding whole invoice.

support-ian: I'll keep customer updated and escalate to account exec. Thanks all :thumbsup:
